text:
sara-sales: Heads up — FinServe exec demo failed. They reported truncated streaming responses in their mobile app webview. Blocking the deal unless we can show mitigation. Can we triage now?

customer-eng: Confirmed. Using hosted us-west. App uses in-app Chrome webview; JS SDK v1.2.0. Symptoms: most streams ok, but ~15% end with incomplete JSON / parser exceptions. Seen a 502 and a few socket resets.

devon-se: Oncall here. Any chance they're using an HTTP proxy or injecting content? Mobile carriers sometimes do odd buffering.

customer-eng: They run CloudFront + internal edge proxy. No explicit transforms reported. They do have an enterprise TLS inspection appliance in their corp VPN.

jun-engineering: That TLS inspection could re-chunk responses. Can you reproduce outside their app (desktop Chrome / curl)?

customer-eng: Desktop Chrome OK. curl OK. Only fails in the embedded webview.

maya-qa: Can you capture the raw bytes of a failed stream and the SDK debug trace? If not, a small sample of the event fragments helps.

customer-eng: Pasting one failed capture from console (webview):

```
data: {"chunkId":"c1","payload":"{\"text\":\"Starting tran"


data: {"chunkId":"c1","payload":"saction: #12345\"}"
```

customer-eng: Client error: `Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input` at line parse in our SDK.

alex-support: Two front-running possibilities: 1) upstream chunking/splitting mid-UTF8 or mid-JSON, 2) the webview network layer coalesces / splits SSE frames differently than desktop. We should add a defensive reassembly in the SDK.

jun-engineering: Agreed. For quick POC fix: implement tolerant parser that buffers incomplete events up to 1s before failing, with an opt-in debug mode to log raw event bytes and checksums (sha1) to correlate with server logs.

devon-se: Also add a fallback on parse error to re-request the same response as a non-streaming full payload (if the request is idempotent) so critical flows don't show partial output to end-users.

customer-eng: That fallback would be acceptable for the demo. Execs need assurance and a written mitigation plan.

alex-support: I'll check infra metrics for any edge 502 spikes or connection resets around reported times. infra-bot: recent deploys?

infra-bot: Deploy log: edge-config updated 2025-09-10T02:14Z — keepalive timeout lowered from 60s to 15s in us-west.

maya-qa: That keepalive change is huge — could explain premature connection closing if the webview pauses. Ask infra to revert or increase for the POC.

jun-engineering: Good catch. If keepalive is 15s and the client pauses backgrounding, the connection can close mid-event. We should recommend 60s for mobile webviews.

customer-eng: I'll escalate to their infra team.

sara-sales: Also, they raised a contractual question: will streaming count against their committed tokens for Dedicated? They're worried about burst costs for high-frequency streaming. Can someone outline pricing/migration options quickly?

devon-se: Short answer: hosted usage billed per token; Dedicated offers committed capacity with predictable unit cost and rate limits you control. For the POC, offer a trial Dedicated seat for their demo to avoid overage concerns. I'll coordinate pricing with sales ops.

alex-support: Action items for immediate POC:
- provide patched JS SDK (len-prefixed debug + tolerant buffer)
- ask customer to enable SDK debug and share raw frames/HAR from webview
- ask their infra to temporarily set edge keepalive to >= 60s
- supply a fallback non-streaming endpoint for critical demo flows

maya-qa: I'll create a tiny repro harness that mimics webview behavior and deliberately splits SSE events mid-byte so we can validate the patch quickly.

jun-engineering: I'll prepare a short runbook and a technical note the customer can share with their security team explaining how we handle partial streams, replay safety, and logs (no PII).

customer-eng: They also have an infosec Q: do you persist raw streaming bodies in logs? They need confirmation for compliance.

alex-support: We persist request/response metadata and truncated debug traces when debug enabled; we redact PII by default. I'll send the security blurb.

sara-sales: Timeline: customer execs at 16:00 PT tomorrow. Can we have the SDK patch, repro validation, and the mitigation note before then?

devon-se: We can ship a POC patch within 2 hours. Will post link to artifact and install instructions.

jun-engineering: I'll sign off on the runbook and a mitigation checklist for QA to run before the demo.

maya-qa: Repro harness ready in ~90 mins once I finish the split-frame simulator.

alex-support: Infra team rolling back keepalive change now for us-west POC traffic window.

customer-eng: Thanks — please ping me in the customer channel when ready.

sara-sales: Thanks team. Keep updates here. After the demo we should capture a short postmortem and add a KB entry about webview SSE gotchas for future POCs. :memo: :rocket:
